card.name: Endings of Spanish and French adjectives
card.fires_on: The final piece of a Romance-language adjective split across pieces, such as mar-ít-ima or med-ica, mostly in Spanish text and URLs. It also fires weakly on English adjectives like professional or musical.

modes.label: Spanish adjective endings
modes.description: The last piece of a Spanish word such as marítima or médica, often inside a URL or Spanish sentence.
modes.example: La controversia mar<<ít>>ima de Perú y Chile, puede

modes.label: French adjective ending
modes.description: The closing piece of a French adjective in a title.
modes.example: the Année littéra<<ire>>. Thus Fréron, in recruiting

modes.label: English adjectives before culture or calibre
modes.description: Weaker firing on English adjectives such as professional or musical before a noun.
